info.name: MetaMapa
info.description: Requests for every MetaMapa service, organized by service and feature. Base URLs, tokens and test credentials come from the environment (see MetaMapa.local.postman_environment.example.json). Requests to the services ports call them directly; requests that use APIGateway-baseUrl go through the gateway and its route-security rules. Login, register and refresh store the returned tokens in AccessToken and RefreshToken.

item.description: One request per route-security rule, with the expected status code asserted. Run it after Auth, with the freshly registered CONTRIBUTOR user: an ADMIN user would get 200 on the ADMIN routes. It also checks the negative cases (no token, malformed token, refresh token used as an access token) and that identity headers sent by the client never reach the services.

item.description: Requests through the API Gateway, with automated assertions. Run the whole folder in order (Collection Runner or Newman) with a username that does not exist yet: Auth registers it and stores the tokens, Tests checks every route-security rule, and the last two requests submit an event anonymously and read the public feed.
